acceptanceCriteria: On a darwin host without the Homebrew go1.27.1 receipt (a hosted macos-15 runner), cmd/corvint-analyzer-go builds its compiled CLI with the go1.27.1 on PATH and its GOROOT, and the package passes.
The owner-host path keeps the exact Homebrew receipt, so local behaviour is unchanged.
The hosted release-gates macos-15 full-gate passes cmd/corvint-analyzer-go.
body: Observed in the owner-dispatched release-gates run 36338249213, attempt 2, macos-15 full-gate on c9019c4b: six cmd/corvint-analyzer-go tests (TestCompiledCLICompleteBoundaryMatrix, TestCompiledCLIFrozenGoldens, TestCompiledCLI1024DistinctFreshProcessCorpus, TestProductionAttemptObservingSpy, TestProductionGoRuntimeGetenvTrap, TestProductionCapabilitySandboxSpy) failed with `fork/exec /opt/homebrew/Cellar/go/1.27.1/libexec/bin/go: no such file or directory` or `open /opt/homebrew/Cellar/go/1.27.1/libexec/src/os/env.go`. Cause: on darwin, compiled_cli_test.go pins `pinnedGoTool` and GOROOT to the owner host's Homebrew receipt, and getenvTrapOverlay derives GOROOT from it; the hosted runner's go1.27.1 comes from actions/setup-go. Every other package passed. The failure is deterministic, so every hosted macOS full gate fails until it is fixed.

completion.reason: Fixed in #294 (a97d311d). Verified on candidate b967f6bbe33c5eba367a07d7eeb2bd1e372e9162 (tree 76c65185, identical to PR head ae02388d): hosted release-gates run 36349510836 passed make gate on ubuntu-24.04 (job 108705305284) and macos-15 (job 108705305319). internal/analyzergo and cmd/corvint-analyzer-go report ok on hosted macos-15, where they failed on c9019c4b in run 36338249213, and on ubuntu. title: analyzer-go: darwin tests pin the owner host's Homebrew Go, so the hosted macOS full gate fails
